# May17 — Odoo apps

> Paid Odoo 19 modules by Thinh Nguyen Huu. Each module is self-contained, modifies no Odoo core
> file, and is sold on the Odoo Apps Store under OPL-1.

## Modules

- [AI Assistant and Reports](https://apps.odoo.com/apps/modules/19.0/ai_assistant_reports): AI
  assistant for Odoo 19 Community and Enterprise, $249. Answers questions asked in plain English
  with live reports, charts, financial statements and Excel downloads. Ships 20 built-in tools and
  five financial statements — Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet, Trial Balance, Aged Receivable and
  Aged Payable — computed from account.move.line rather than through Odoo's Enterprise-only
  accounting reports engine, so Community gets them too. Connects to a self-hosted Ollama server
  (no API key, nothing leaves the network) or to Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Azure
  OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Charts render as server-side SVG with no external
  request. Every write is approved by a human first, and every query runs with the asking user's
  own access rights. Depends on base and web only; no Python package to install.
- [May17 Dashboard](https://apps.odoo.com/apps/modules/19.0/may17_dashboard): dashboard builder
  for Odoo 19 Community and Enterprise. Builds interactive dashboards from any Odoo model with no
  code, using 17 item types (13 chart types), 10 one-click templates, and a live chart preview
  inside the configuration form. Depends on base, web and sale only. Exports charts to PNG, data
  to .xlsx, and the dashboard to PDF from the browser. Charts render with Apache ECharts bundled
  in the module, so nothing is requested from outside the server.
- [List Quick Filter](https://apps.odoo.com/apps/modules/19.0/list_quick_filter): inline
  multi-column filter bar above any Odoo 19 list view, with autocomplete tags and 8 operators.
- [Month and Year Picker](https://apps.odoo.com/apps/modules/19.0/may17_month_picker): four field
  widgets that show only the month or only the year on date and datetime fields.
